meta.title: eGovFrame Security Patch Observatory
meta.scope: Curated public evidence for eGovFrame common-components and runtime security patch tracking
meta.note: This is a defensive patch-intelligence view. It does not prove a deployed system is vulnerable or fixed without source/config/runtime verification.

events.title: 23년 보안패치
events.summary: Batch path restriction, sitemap test-function removal, CKEditor/XSS hardening, filesystem input handling and other secure-coding changes.

events.title: 24년 보안패치
events.summary: Additional filesystem-monitor input hardening and related secure-coding fixes.

events.title: 25년 보안패치
events.summary: Introduces base-path validation and constrains FileTool and Sync Server file operations to approved roots.

events.title: 인증인가처리 수정
events.summary: Authentication/authorization refactoring cited in Project Canopy's public report as part of the early remediation track.

events.title: 5.0.2 패치 내용 추가
events.summary: Large patch set including the @RequireAdmin control model and broad controller hardening.

events.title: KISA 취약점 보안 패치
events.summary: Broad security patch across user management, templates, monitoring views and other common components.

events.title: KISA 취약점 보안 패치
events.summary: Companion security patch with controller authorization and view/output hardening.

events.title: NCSC 보안점검 적용
events.summary: Early NCSC review follow-up preceding the larger July hardening series.

events.title: 990 vulnerabilities and patching report
events.summary: Project Canopy publicly reported 990 findings/candidates, including 94 Critical/High, and described a remediation program with eGovFrame maintainers.

events.title: NCSC 보안점검 적용
events.summary: Large-scale hardening wave across approximately 300 files, including request method restrictions and security checks.

events.title: NCSC&NIA 보안점검 적용
events.summary: Ownership checks, admin restrictions, getImage MIME hardening and multiple object-level authorization fixes.

events.title: 인증 및 권한 검증 로직 공통화
events.summary: Authorization logic continued to be refactored and centralized after the July patch waves.

events.title: 부서일정 상세조회 소유권 검증 추가
events.summary: Adds object ownership verification for department schedule detail access.

events.title: 만족도조사 상세조회 소유권 검증 추가
events.summary: Adds ownership verification to satisfaction-survey detail access.

events.title: 장애신청 수정화면 소유권 검증 추가
events.summary: Continued object-level authorization remediation in September 2026.

events.title: Department authorization changes require admin
events.summary: Admin authorization fixes were still landing one day before this dashboard snapshot.

events.title: Admin handling for employee modify/delete
events.summary: Latest authorization behavior continued to change in user-management paths.
